messages:
Lara Mitchell: Spectra sent back an RFI with three non-negotiables: EU-only processing, SSO/SAML support, and a pen-test report excerpt. They also want an estimate for 200 qps sustained during a 30-day PoC. I uploaded their RFI: spectra_rfi_v4.xlsx. Can we split sections?
Omar Ruiz: I'll take infra (data residency + egress) and PoC sizing. Quick note: 200 qps sustained likely needs Dedicated large or Private depending on payload size. Need expected token/sec to size GPU pool.
Ben Cho: I'll handle security (SSO, pen-test). We have SOC2 + ISO; pen-test is available under NDA. SSO via SAML/OIDC is supported for Console and API keys via SSO provisioning.
Priya Shah: I'll own pricing and SOW. Spectra asked for a 30% pilot discount and SLA on canary rollback windows. Also asked whether we offer a refundable deposit.
rfi-bot: File uploaded: spectra_rfi_v4.xlsx (by Lara Mitchell)
Omar Ruiz: For 200 qps: assume avg 15 tokens per request and 20 tokens per second per qps? rough calc: 200 qps * 15 tokens = 3k tokens/sec -> ~259M tokens/day. Recommend Dedicated large (6x A100 equiv) or Private depending on residency. I'll add perf caveats.
Lara Mitchell: perfect. Also they want support for customer-managed keys in EU with key import. Ben, do we have docs for KMS import flow?
Ben Cho: yes 6 we support customer-managed KMS. For cloud we integrate with customer KMS and for on-prem we support HSM via PKCS#11. Include snippet: `import_key(pkcs12) -> wrap_key_with_kms(); configure_rotation(days=30)`. Pen-test: we can share redacted executive summary after NDA.
Priya Shah: Pricing bullets: hosted per-token baseline; Dedicated monthly commit tiers with stepped discounts; Private one-time license + infra estimate. For 30-day PoC: propose 30% off hosted or a pro-rated Dedicated pilot with a refundable GPU reservation deposit. I'll draft numbers.
Omar Ruiz: Data residency: we can enforce EU-only routing and disallow cross-region backups by policy. If Spectra needs cross-border backups we need to document egress and explicit consent.
Ben Cho: SSO details: we support SAML 2.0, SCIM provisioning for users, and can disable local passwords. Add sample SAML config snippet in answers.
Lara Mitchell: they also asked about canary guarantees: want a guarantee that canary <5% of traffic for 72 hrs with zero more than 0.5% error. Ops: do we have automatic rollback thresholds?
Omar Ruiz: yes 6 we have route-level circuit breakers. Suggested text: "Canary traffic can be limited by percent and observed for metric thresholds; automatic rollback triggers on error-rate >0.5% sustained for 5min or latency p95 increase >2x."
Priya Shah: SOW note: include integration week, 2-week perf validation (we'll run 3-day stress window), and final tuning. Recommend refundable deposit to cover reserved capacity. I'll attach PoC SOW draft.
rfi-bot: File uploaded: spectra_poc_sow_draft.pdf (by Priya Shah)
Ben Cho: Security Q: pen test summary + vuln SLA. We commit to triage critical issues within 48h and provide remediation paths. Also include our responsible disclosure process.
Lara Mitchell: timeline 6 next steps: can we finalize the RFI packet (answers doc + capability matrix + SOW + pricing) by EOD? AE wants to send tomorrow morning.
Omar Ruiz: I'll post sizing numbers and recommended Dedicated configs by 3pm.
Priya Shah: I'll have pricing + SOW final by 5pm.
Ben Cho: I'll get the pen-test summary (redacted) + SSO config snippet by 4pm.
Lara Mitchell: thanks all. Quick sync 2:40pm? 20 minutes to finalize any blockers.
Priya Shah: 2:40 works.
Omar Ruiz: noted.
Ben Cho: on calendar. :thumbsup:
Lara Mitchell: closing thread 6 I'll combine attachments after 5pm and post link here.
